Assert Order.name: Assert Order
Assert Order.description: A mark of the caster's choice appears above a willing target for the spell's duration. When a resistance check or save that inflicts damage targets them, they may add 3 + 1/2F up to 2 + 1/2F times to the die roll before the mark and spell expires. All uses count, even if they are not resisted.

Assert Life.name: Assert Life
Assert Life.description: A mark of the caster's choice appears above all targets for the spell's duration. Targets become subject to the following affects: \nAll living targets regain 6 + 1/F d10 HP. Any excess HP is converted into a temporary HP barrier that lasts for 1 minute . The barrier absorbs the pool's worth of damage before breaking, all remaining damage continuing as normal. \nIf undead, the targets receive 12 + 2/F d10 divine damage, AGI save for half.

Avatar.name: Avatar
Avatar.description: Caster generates a magical divine apparition, becoming resistant to divine damage in the process. As long as the avatar is active, the caster can utilize their swift action to cast any spell from the Life group with an action cost of a core action. Causing a target to recover HP while Avatar is active also confers the benefits of Assert Order (Life -1) to them.

Bastion of Dawn.name: Bastion of Dawn
Bastion of Dawn.description: A sigil is affixed to the target, creating a 30 + 5/F temporary HP barrier. This spell provides 4 + 1/4F bonus DVs until broken. When a resistance check or save that targets them, they gain a placed roll as long as the barrier persists.

Hallowed Stance.name: Hallowed Stance
Hallowed Stance.description: A translucent barrier engulfs the target; when struck by an attack roll they may spend a reaction contest their WIL with the attacker. On success, they negate the damage of that attack. When they negate damage, they can spend a swift action to cause a target within 50' to recover that amount of damage.

Healing Touch.name: Healing Touch
Healing Touch.description: Caster touches an object or living creature and activates one of the following effects: \nObject: A small object is restored to pristine condition, reversing any damage caused in the last hour. This cannot influence magic items, any sentient item has a WIL save to negate. \nCreature: The target recovers 2 + 1/F d10 HP.

Helping Hand.name: Helping Hand
Helping Hand.description: Caster aids the target by granting them a placed roll on the next attack roll, resistance check/save, or skill check of choice. The caster may use this ability (Rank) times per day.

Honor Guard.name: Honor Guard
Honor Guard.description: A sigil is affixed to the target, creating a 12 + 5/F temporary HP barrier. The barrier provides the targets with 2 + 1/2F bonus DVs until broken.

Lifeline.name: Lifeline
Lifeline.description: Upon seeing a target go under 0 HP, caster reaches out towards their life essence - suffusing it with energy. The target's HP is instead set to 0 and they immediately recover 4 + 1/F d10 HP.

Lifeplate.name: Lifeplate
Lifeplate.description: An ethereal coat of energy covers the target for the duration of the spell, or until the armor breaks. This armor grants a target 4 + 1/4F bonus DVs and 6 instances of elemental damage reduction. The armor blocks all damage until it has taken 40 + 8/F damage, at which point it breaks - no longer providing a benefit (breaking naturally at the end of the duration.) Upon breaking, an explosion radiates around the caster - causing all, including the target to recover 20 HP in a 10' radius.

Mass Heal.name: Mass Heal
Mass Heal.description: A mark of the caster's choice appears above 4 + 1/F willing targets - infusing them with life energy. All targets recover 7 + 1/2F d12 HP, any excess HP over the target's maximum converts into a temporary HP barrier that persists for 1 minute.

Major Preservation.name: Major Preservation
Major Preservation.description: Caster touches an object (up to about the size of a house) - enhancing and preserving it. The object is restored to pristine condition, reversing any damage caused in the last hour. \nIf the item is a weapon, it gains 1 placed roll on the damage dice. If armor, it gains 3 + 1/4F bonus DVs. \nAn item with limited uses (that can regain them) regains a use; other effects are possible with GM discretion. This ability cannot influence magic items or cause them to regain a spell charge; sentient items may make a WIL save to negate.

Physician's Poppet.name: Physician's Poppet
Physician's Poppet.description:
Willing targets have miniature replicas created of them; appearing within the caster's grip or on their person, of whatever materials are available and appropriate. The poppets may only be used by the caster and they must have the poppet on their person to use it. Once per turn the caster may use a poppet as a swift action or reaction, using a poppet confers one of the following effects to the character the poppet represents: 
Gain a placed roll on the next HEA or WIL save / check over the duration. 
14 HP barrier that persists over the duration. 
Target suffers 10 piercing damage, poppet and the target switch places.

Purge.name: Purge
Purge.description: Caster can choose to remove 2 + 1/2F spell effects/specific effects they name, WIL save to negate. If a specifically named ability is not present; some other random ceases. Targets must always attempt to resist the spell effect. Permanent effects are only suppressed for up to one hour on a failed save.

Rejuvenating Ray.name: Rejuvenating Ray
Rejuvenating Ray.description: A jet of energy spills from the caster's hands toward the target, causing them to recover 6 + 1/F d10 HP. Any excess HP over the target's maximum converts into a temporary HP barrier that persists for 1 minute.

Refresh.name: Refresh
Refresh.description: Caster marks a willing target, empowering them with life energy. Target recovers 1d8 HP at the end of their turn; additionally, the caster may stall 1 + 1/2F negative conditions or abilities until the spell ends, they stop receiving any negative effects or making checks until Refresh ends and then they make the appropriate number of saves/checks and suffer the appropriate consequences for the number of rounds delayed.

Righteousness.name: Righteousness
Righteousness.description:
A mark of the caster's choice appears above all targets. Targets become subject to any 2 + 1/2F of the following effects: 
Targets are stripped of Divine or Blight resistance or DR, HEA save to negate. 
Ethereal targets are made corporeal/physical, HEA save to negate. 
Sentient targets become spell jammed, WIL save to negate. 
Construct/Object targets are rendered inert/deactivated (as unconsciousness), WIL save to negate. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Willing Sacrifice.name: Willing Sacrifice
Willing Sacrifice.description: As a reaction to an attack roll or single-target spell, the caster may use this ability to redirect it to a willing target. The willing target becomes the new target for the ability.
